Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Mini Cinnamon Sugar Donuts! Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the milk, yeast, and sugar. Add the egg, flour, salt, and softened butter all at once, then mix and coil fold the dough several times. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. Coil fold again, cover, and let rise for 2 hours or until doubled in size. 2. Place your dough onto a work surface and shape it into a long log. Using a knife, cut it into 24 equal pieces. 3. Roll each piece into a ball and place it onto a small square of parchment paper. Gently flatten each one, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes. Uncover and let rest for another 5 minutes before frying. 4. Make sure the oil is hot before frying. Carefully place the donuts into the hot oil, gently remove the parchment paper, and fry until golden on both sides. 5. Mix the sugar and cinnamon together. While the donuts are still warm, coat both sides in the cinnamon sugar. #donuts #donut #bread #breadtok #homemade

Add the rice and toast for 2 mins while stirring. Pour in the hot water mixed with bouillon according to package instructions. Stir & bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover & reduce heat to low. Cheesy Crunchwraps with Beef BEEF FILLING 1½ tbsp (25 ml) olive oil 1 lb (500 g) ground beef 1⅔ tsp (5 g) paprika 1 tsp (3 g) garlic powder 1 tsp (3 g) cayenne pepper ⅓ tsp (1 g) black pepper ½ beef bouillon cube (5 g) ⅓ cup (50 g) diced green bell pepper 1 small yellow onion (100 g), finely diced 3 tbsp (50 g) tomato sauce WRAPS 8 large flour tortillas (10-inch) Sauce of your choice (salsa, sour cream or chipotle mayo) Cheese slices (cheddar or Monterey Jack) CHEESE CRUST 1½ cups (150 g) shredded Mexican-blend cheese Instructions Set out all of your ingredients. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne and black pepper. Crumble the beef bouillon cube over the pan. Cook for 3-4 minutes. Stir in the green bell pepper and onion and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add the tomato sauce and cook until everything comes together. Let the filling cool. Lay a tortilla on a clean work surface and place a slice of cheese in the center. Add sauce to taste, then spread about ⅓ cup (80 g) of the beef filling on top. Leave enough space around the edges. Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then fold the top and bottom over to make a tight package. Place it seam side down. Repeat with the remaining tortillas. Heat a skillet over medium-low to medium-high heat and lightly grease it with oil. Cook the burritos for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown and crispy. Lower the heat to medium-low. Sprinkle a small handful of shredded cheese in the center of the pan and let it melt slowly. Place a filled wrap on the melted cheese and cook until the cheese is golden and crispy. Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. Pat steak dry. Thinly slice flank steak against the grain into about ¼-inch strips. Add steak into a medium-sized bowl. 2. For the steak marinade, toss the steak in soy sauce, minced garlic, oil, rice vinegar, cornstarch, black pepper, sugar, and baking soda. Mix well and fully coat the steak in the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, up to 1 hour. 3. To make the sauce, in a separate medium-sized bowl add in soy sauce, beef stock, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and black pepper. Mix and whisk together ingredients well. Set aside. 4. When ready to cook, heat a large skillet to medium-high heat. Add in 2 tbsp cooking oil. Once oil is hot, shimmers and easily moves around the skillet, add steak to the skillet in batches. Be sure not to overcrowd the skillet. Sear steak for about 1 minute to brown and then flip over to continue cooking for an additional 1 minute to brown. Remove from the skillet and repeat until all of the steak is cooked. 5. Once done cooking the steak, reduce heat to medium, add in more oil if necessary, then toss in chopped onion and chopped bell peppers. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and saute for a couple of minutes until onions and peppers are slightly softened. 6. Creamy Tuscan White Beans Ingredients (4-5 servings): • 2 (15-oz) cans white beans, Great Northern or cannellini, drained and rinsed • 1½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved • ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped • 1 small yellow onion, finely diced • 4 garlic cloves, finely minced • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¼ tsp red pepper flakes, plus more to taste • 1 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups broth • ½ cup whole milk • 1 tsp Dijon mustard • ½ cup finely grated Parmesan, plus more for serving • 2–3 cups chopped kale, tough stems removed • 1 tbsp lemon juice • 1 tsp honey • ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper • Salt, to taste • Extra-virgin olive oil, for finishing • Crusty sourdough, for serving Instructions: 1. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add the olive oil and diced onion with a pinch of salt. Cook for 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly golden. 2. videos.caption: Tennessee Onions! 🧅🧀 aka sliced onion rings that are roasted until soft and jammy, then covered in a three cheese blend and broiled until the top is deep golden brown and bubbling.  Get the full recipe at https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/tennessee-onions/ or click the link in our profile and it will take you straight there. Try it for the holidays, or try it sooner with roast chicken or steak and potatoes for a cozy weeknight dinner!  Butter for greasing the dish 2½ pounds Vidalia onions or another sweet onion; about 3 large, sliced ½ inch thick and separated into rings 2 tablespoons butter melted ½ teaspoon beef base Better Than Bouillon 1 teaspoon dried thyme 1 teaspoon dried parsley ½ teaspoon dried oregano ½ teaspoon dry mustard ½ teaspoon smoked paprika ½ teaspoon garlic powder ¾ teaspoon kosher salt ¼ teaspoon black pepper ⅛ teaspoon cayenne pepper ½ cup low-moisture mozzarella shredded (about 2 oz) ¾ cup sharp cheddar shredded (about 3 oz) ½ cup grated Parmesan Preheat the oven to 400˚F. Butter a 9x13 baking dish on the bottom and sides. Slice the onions ½ inch thick, then separate each slice into individual rings. Keep the rings whole as much as you can, but a few broken ones are fine. Whisk the beef base into the melted butter until smooth. To a very large bowl, add the onion rings and the butter mixture and toss until every ring is coated. Sprinkle the thyme, parsley, oregano, dry mustard, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper and cayenne over the top. Set a second bowl of about the same size upside down over the first and shake until the onions are evenly coated. Arrange the rings in the buttered dish so they lie mostly flat and intact. They don't need to be in perfect rows, but don't pile them in a heap. Roast, uncovered, for 35 to 40 minutes, until the onions are very soft and starting to color at the edges. If they begin to brown too quickly, lay a sheet of foil loosely over the top for the remaining time. (The goal is to drive off moisture, so don't crimp the foil tightly.) Remove the dish from the oven. If there is liquid pooled in the bottom, sop it up with paper towels. Too much liquid will make the cheese gummy underneath. Scatter the mozzarella and cheddar over the onions, then the Parmesan. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and just starting to brown. Switch the oven to broil and broil until the top is deep golden brown and bubbling, watching closely the whole time. Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

Classic Patty Melt Recipe Ingredients 1 lb 450 g ground beef (80/20 for best flavor) 4 slices rye bread 4 slices Swiss cheese 1 medium onion thinly sliced 2 tablespoons butter plus more for bread ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon black pepper ½ teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce 1 tablespoon oil Instructions Caramelize the onions Heat oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add sliced onions and cook slowly, stirring often, until soft, golden, and sweet (about 8–10 minutes). Remove from pan and set aside. Form the patties Divide beef into 2 thin oval patties shaped to match bread size. Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and Worcestershire sauce. Cook the burgers In the same skillet, cook patties over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side until fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Assemble the melts Butter one side of each bread slice. On the unbuttered side, layer: Swiss cheese Beef patty Caramelized onions Another slice of Swiss cheese Top with another slice of bread (buttered side facing out). Grill to perfection Place sandwiches in the skillet over medium heat. Cook 3–4 minutes per side, pressing gently, until bread is golden and cheese is fully melted. Serve Slice in half and serve hot with fries, chips, or pickles.
